issue.title: Bound agent scratch by ownership, not by environment luck
issue.description: Per-launch agent scratch (cargo targets, agent TMPDIRs) is removed when its launch is dead, on every managed temp root any writer actually used, regardless of which environment the service host was started with; cleanup refusals are visible; and `sase disk list` / disk-pressure notifications account for where the bytes really are, so a SASE host can no longer silently fill its disk.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/bounded_agent_scratch.md requests this work

issue.title: Managed temp root registry the reaper follows
issue.description: root-registry: every root `get_sase_managed_tmpdir()` writes into is recorded in a Rust-owned registry under SASE_HOME, and every managed-tmp reaper entry point reaps all registered roots instead of only the root its own environment resolves.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/bounded_agent_scratch.md defines phase root-registry as one work unit

issue.title: Rust-owned launch scratch liveness that works under systemd
issue.description: scratch-liveness: move the procfs liveness probe into sase-core, stop treating pre-launch non-dumpable processes (systemd --user, sd-pam, ssh-agent) as incomplete observations, and make runner-exit cleanup log every outcome.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/bounded_agent_scratch.md defines phase scratch-liveness as one work unit

issue.title: Dead-launch backstop pass and liveness-aware pressure
issue.description: dead-launch-reap: the housekeeping reaper removes launch-keyed scratch that no live process holds after a short grace, pressure pruning becomes liveness-aware with a realistic minimum entry size, and defaults and docs move with it.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/bounded_agent_scratch.md defines phase dead-launch-reap as one work unit

issue.title: Truthful disk attribution under pressure
issue.description: disk-attribution: `sase disk list` and the disk_pressure job cover every registered root and every workspace checkout before the stray walk, report unattributed bytes, and workspace compaction stops over-reporting hardlinked bytes.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/bounded_agent_scratch.md defines phase disk-attribution as one work unit

issue.title: Retention for visual snapshot run reports
issue.description: visual-run-retention: the visual maintenance tooling prunes old `.pytest_cache/sase-visual/runs/` directories while preserving the latest report, recent runs, and any unfinished apply journal.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/bounded_agent_scratch.md defines phase visual-run-retention as one work unit

issue.title: Integrated acceptance on apollo and athena
issue.description: host-acceptance: after deployment, prove on apollo and athena that the registry finds the agent root, runner exit removes scratch, the backstop reaps dead launches, and disk attribution matches df.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/bounded_agent_scratch.md defines phase host-acceptance as one work unit
